$comment: FlipCard (digital business card) copy. Editable content — safe for a CMS. WHICH FACE IS WHICH: the card rests on the 'Why Choose Us' face, and flips to the contact face — `reasons` is the resting face, `defaults.phoneNumbers`/`email`/`qrCode` are the flip side. Each reason's `color` is the accent that src/data/flipCard.js expands into that row's background tint, border tint and pulse timing — keep the six colours distinct so consecutive rows stay separable. Rows render with a tick icon, so no `icon` key is needed. Keep labels SHORT (about 34 characters): these are claims, not sentences, and a row that wraps to two lines breaks the rhythm of the list. Both faces use the same logo file on purpose — see `defaults.logo`.

reasons.label: We'll Say If You're Not Ready

defaults.qrAlt: Scan for Young Architects contact details
